mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT capability.capability_code FROM auth_principal principal JOIN auth_principal_role_assignment assignment ON assignment.principal_id = principal.principal_id JOIN auth_role_capability role_capability ON role_capability.role_id = assignment.role_id JOIN auth_capability capability ON capability.capability_id = role_capability.capability_id WHERE principal.principal_id = #{principalId} AND principal.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.valid_from <= #{at} AND (assignment.valid_to IS NULL OR assignment.valid_to > #{at}) ORDER BY capability.capability_code
